summary.text: R&D Lead and Senior Full Stack Developer with 10+ years building e-commerce, healthcare, and enterprise integration platforms. Specialized in Next.js, TypeScript, Shopify and HubSpot integrations, GCP/Firebase infrastructure, and AI workflow automation. Recently led HIPAA-compliant telemedicine and e-commerce systems with 99.9% uptime, 85% fewer integration failures, and major performance gains across mobile funnels.
